stance_basis: suggests an alternate alignment rather than opposing or endorsing the proposed project outright
summary: Ernest F. Vilter, a private citizen, proposed an alternate alignment for the Airport Spur that would leave I-94 at approximately the point where it turns west and then head southwest of the buildings along Howell Avenue. His comment reflects a conditional or alternative-seeking position rather than outright opposition or support. The agency responded that his suggested alignment is similar to Alternate #4 already investigated in the Final EIS.
